notes: Cross-verse split with LEV.7.23. Both verses write kol on the noun and lo on the verb with a single English no answering to the pair, but 7.23 fused them on that word while 7.26 gave no to lo and manner to kol. Rule 35 rules on this shape by name (wekol-melakhah lo taasu, shall do no manner of work): the one word carries both the quantification and the negation, so the two morphemes share one discontinuous unit headed on the negative, and the noun keeps its own English including the generic the ASV supplies to expand it, so manner of blood is dam's, headed on blood. 7.26 is brought into line with 7.23 and with that ruling.
